$description: SalkarsaUI design tokens (W3C DTCG), generated from Figma 2026-11-13. Semantic groups reference primitives. "light" and "dark" use identical token names. CSS name = path joined with "-" (e.g. light.bg.default -> --bg-default). Breakpoints live in spacing.breakpoint.

default.$description: Default app/screen background. Use for the base layer of every screen.

subtle.$description: Slightly tinted background for secondary sections, grouped list backgrounds, inputs at rest.

muted.$description: Muted fill for hover/pressed neutral areas, skeletons, track of Switch/Progress.

transparent.$description: Fully transparent fill. Use for Ghost buttons and resettable backgrounds instead of removing the fill.
